entities.name: José Cepeda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Arturo Cepeda Escobedo, known as Arturo Cepeda, is a Mexican-American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who has served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of San Antonio since 2025. He worked as a priest in San Antonio from 1996 to 2011 and then as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Detroit in Michigan from 2011 to 2025.
